title: AfD on the rise – European Council on Foreign Relations
gist: Podcast episode page (show notes only) in which Mark Leonard discusses ECFR's 'Deutschland First' policy brief with Jeremy Cliffe and Jana Puglierin: with Germany's economy stagnating and the AfD competing to become the largest party, the firewall is under strain and the AfD could reshape German politics and Europe without entering government. Content is limited to the episode description.

themes.theme: AfD rise and a less compromising Germany

insights.claim: With Germany's economy stagnating, its mainstream parties weakened and the AfD now competing to become Germany's largest party, the political 'firewall' keeping the AfD from power is under growing strain.
insights.speaker: Jeremy Cliffe, Mark Leonard, Jana Puglierin
insights.so_what: German political risk is rising; watch polling and state-level firewall breaches as leading indicators.
insights.quote: the political “firewall” keeping it from power is under growing strain

insights.claim: ECFR's base-case scenario running to 2032 explores how the AfD could reshape German politics without even entering government.
insights.speaker: Jeremy Cliffe, Mark Leonard, Jana Puglierin
insights.so_what: Influence-from-opposition matters: policy drift can occur without an AfD-led government.
insights.quote: how the AfD could reshape German politics without the party even entering government

insights.claim: Europe needs to prepare for a Germany less willing to make the compromises that once held the European project together, with implications for rearmament, support for Ukraine and EU enlargement.
insights.speaker: Jeremy Cliffe, Mark Leonard, Jana Puglierin
insights.so_what: Lower odds of German-backed EU fiscal compromises; watch EU budget, Ukraine funding and enlargement files.
insights.quote: a Germany less willing to make the compromises that once held the European project together

insights.claim: The AfD is internally divided on economics, the US and Russia, and is gaining ground in both Germany's east and west.
insights.speaker: Jeremy Cliffe, Mark Leonard, Jana Puglierin
insights.so_what: Internal splits create uncertainty about AfD policy direction on Russia and transatlantic ties.
insights.locator: Why is the AfD gaining ground

source_meta.author: Jeremy Cliffe, Mark Leonard, Jana Puglierin
